front.source_observation: Street/corner overview: giant C frame retains its high inset opaque green pane, separate right-hand floor ends/open strips and low horizontal glazing. Ten principal rounded glass intervals, upper single window and A outer small-window rhythm remain distinct. No adjacent buildings are included.

rear.source_observation: Campus overview: long A extension, E multilevel crosslink, nonparallel B wing, D seven corner-window bands, tall lower glazing, open entry and broader projecting upper glass box remain legible. Box grooves and opaque colors are original simplified model details.

east.source_observation: Local +X elevation, not a surveyed compass east: tall recessed pane within C is visible on the existing end/support surfaces; slab ends and open strips remain separate. Low glazing and ground portal are not filled by the material change. C ten glass intervals retained.

west.source_observation: Local -X elevation: paper-left A short end is conservatively plain, not a mirrored copy of the long facade. E stacked open galleries and the D overhanging box remain distinct. Partial corner-window recesses are deliberately generalized; a blank model wall is not a claim of no actual windows.

south.source_observation: Local -Y elevation/campus side: D has seven ordinary corner bands below the higher projecting glass box, a taller low glass panel, genuine ground entry, sparse adjacent core openings and independent B broad-window rhythm. The A glass stair and inward gallery are separate landmarks.

north.source_observation: Local +Y long outer facade: fine paired-window approximation differs from inward galleries; narrow vertical glass strip and unequal end treatment retained. C ten round glass intervals plus separate upper single window visible. Counts/spacing of small ordinary windows are generalized, not a measured elevation.

top.source_observation: Top view preserves long A extension, nonparallel B, D projection and separate large trapezoidal courtyard/smaller end void, with E/F/C connections. Print-scale roundings and rooted terminal supports do not merge the voids. Simple visible roof cores exclude invented equipment and are not a complete roof survey.

courtyard-gallery.source_observation: Deliberate high downward perspective into the large court: repeated side galleries, recessed opaque windows and F crossing are visible through a deep open shaft. Darker ground and render grain remain visible; no geometry is concealed by a cropped facade or filled court. 2021 photo supports this topology, not the precise early rail/fitout details.

courtyard-arcade.source_observation: Repositioned high downward perspective into the smaller end void shows both side slab stacks, depth and the bright actual street-end aperture beside the tall opaque green pane. The earlier near-wall view was rejected. This image supports a distinct small shaft, without asserting measured dimensions or a fully documented early small-courtyard finish.
